DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらで拾われましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅前のベンチです。この封筒を拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った場所と封筒を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: On a bench in front of the station. I found this envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and give the discovery location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拾ったときから封は閉じていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was it sealed when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、閉じたままです。持ち主の名前を探すために開けるべきか迷い、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封は閉じたままで開封を迷った経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, and it is still closed. I wondered whether to open it to look for the owner's name, and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it remains sealed and you were unsure about opening it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で開ける必要はありません。外側に書かれていることを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You do not need to open it yourself. We will check what is written outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それでは開けずにお渡しします。表に数字がありますが、口座番号かどうかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開けずに渡し外側の数字の意味は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will hand it over unopened. There are numbers on the front, but I do not know whether they are an account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hand it over unopened and say the meaning of the numbers outside is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数字の意味は決めつけずに記録します。拾った時刻はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the numbers without assuming their meaning. What time did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後二時ごろです。近くの人に触ってもらわず、そのまま持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾った時刻と他人に触らせていないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: About two in the afternoon. I brought it as it was without having anyone nearby touch it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the finding time and explain that you did not have others touch it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。届けた方の連絡先について伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. May we ask for your contact details as the person handing it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。持ち主を探すために封筒の写真をネットへ載せることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先確認に応じ写真をネットに掲載しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not post a photo of the envelope online to look for the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to contact-detail confirmation and say that you will not post the photo online. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで受け付けます。必要な確認と届け出の手続きについて順にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it here. We will explain the necessary checks and reporting procedure in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、新しい家にこの郵便が届きました。私の転居届が間違っているのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新住所に郵便が届き転居届を心配していることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this mail arrived at my new home. Is there an error in my change-of-address notification?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that mail arrived at your new address and you are worried about your moving notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず宛名を確認します。お名前はご本人のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let us check the addressee. Is it your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、知らない名前です。住所は今の家と同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所は合うが宛名は知らない人だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it is an unfamiliar name. The address matches my current home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the address matches but the addressee is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人宛ての転送とは分けて確認します。封筒は開けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check this separately from forwarding addressed to you. Have you opened the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けていません。前の住人かもしれませんが、誰なのかは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で相手の身元は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. It might be a previous resident, but I have not confirmed who it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is unopened and the person's identity is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま担当へお渡しください。ほかにも同じ宛名の郵便がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give it to the staff member as it is. Is there any other mail with the same addressee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日はこの一通だけです。自分の郵便と混ぜず、別にして持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一通だけを本人の郵便と分けて持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only this one today. I brought it separately without mixing it with my own mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought only one letter, separate from your own mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から扱いをご案内します。知らない方の転送先をご自身で書き足す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain how to handle it. You do not need to write in a forwarding address for someone you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。宛先を書き換えたり、自分の転居届を取り消したりせず、まずこの一通を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書換えや転居届取消をせず個別の郵便を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not rewrite the address or cancel my own moving notification; I will ask about this one letter first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the individual letter without rewriting it or canceling your moving notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の転送に別の問題があれば、それは改めて分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. If there is another problem with your own forwarding, we will hear about that separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの登録情報を変更されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which registered information would you like to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 名前のカタカナが一文字違っています。名前を変えたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一文字の表記違いで改名ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: One character in my katakana name is different. I have not changed my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that it is a one-character spelling difference, not a name change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が、どの書類と異なっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which part differs from which document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 登録ではマリになっていますが、本人の書類ではマーリです。長い音の記号がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録と本人書類の長音の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The registration says マリ, but my own document says マーリ. The long-vowel mark is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the difference in the long-vowel mark between registration and your document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の書類と現在の登録を担当が確認します。別の表記を新しく希望しているのではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check your identity document and current registration. You are not requesting a new alternate spelling, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、書類と合っているかの確認です。自分の判断で別名の口座を作るつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 書類との照合を求め別名口座を作る意図はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct. I want to check whether it matches my documents. I do not intend to open an account under another name on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for comparison with your documents and explain that you do not intend an alternate-name account. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認に使える書類を拝見します。関連するカードや明細もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us see a document usable for identity verification. Do you also have related cards or statements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらにあります。どの資料の表記が違うか、順に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 関連資料の表記を順に示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. I will show in order which document has a different spelling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the spellings on related documents in order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正の可否と方法を確認します。訂正が反映されるまでの予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check whether and how it can be corrected. Do you have anything planned before the correction is reflected?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 振込を受ける予定があります。相手に伝える名前を、担当に確認してから知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取振込の相手に伝える名前を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I expect to receive a transfer. I want to check with the staff member before telling the sender what name to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the name to tell the person sending a transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当に引き継ぎます。登録状況と振込時の案内を確認してから、相手へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass it to the staff member. Please check the registration status and transfer instructions before contacting the sender.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which product are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱の写真に卵が写っていますが、商品にも卵が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真の卵が商品に含まれるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is an egg in the photo on this box. Does the product also contain egg?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the egg in the photo is included in the product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真だけでは判断できません。写真の下には何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot tell from the photo alone. What does it say below the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 調理例と書いてあります。写真の具が全部入っているとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 調理例で写真の具が全部入るとは限らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says serving suggestion. So not all the ingredients pictured are necessarily included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that a preparation example does not mean all pictured ingredients are included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。実際の原材料表示と、追加する材料の説明を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Let us check the actual ingredients separately from instructions about ingredients to add.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私は卵を避ける必要があるので、原材料と注意書きを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵を避ける必要があり原材料と注意書きを見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I need to avoid eggs, so I want to check the ingredients and caution statements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need to avoid eggs and want to inspect ingredients and warnings. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示を一緒に確認します。不明な点があれば製造元へ問い合わせる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the label together. If anything is unclear, we will need to ask the manufacturer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。写真から入っていないと判断することもせず、不明なら購入を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示が不明なら購入を待つ方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not use the photo to decide it contains no egg either. If it is unclear, I will wait before buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you will wait to buy if the label is unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 調理の際に追加する材料には卵と記載されています。調理方法も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Egg is listed among ingredients to add during cooking. Would you like to check the preparation method too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で卵を加えないだけで食べられるとは考えず、商品自体の表示から確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加の卵を省くだけで判断せず商品自体の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not assume it is safe for me just by omitting the egg I add; I will check the product's own label first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to check the product itself rather than decide just by omitting added egg. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示と問い合わせ先をご案内します。摂取の判断が必要な場合は医療者にもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will explain the label and contact details. If you need a decision about consuming it, please also check with a medical professional.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような休憩場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of rest area are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨が降りそうなので、屋根の下で座りたいです。休憩所の看板がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨を避けて座りたいことと看板を見たことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It looks like rain, so I want to sit under a roof. I saw a rest-area sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to sit out of the rain and saw a sign. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 休憩所の設備と今の利用状況は別に確認しましょう。看板だけでは空席はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the facilities separately from current availability. The sign alone does not tell us whether there are seats free.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。屋根もあると決めていましたが、座れる場所と合わせて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋根と座れる場所を実際に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's true. I also assumed it had a roof, but I want to check that together with somewhere to sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the actual roof and seating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現場の担当に確認します。屋根付きの席が使えない場合はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check with on-site staff. What will you do if covered seating is unavailable?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ぬれる前に散歩を終えます。無理に遠い場所まで探しに行くつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用できなければ散歩を終える方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will end my walk before getting wet. I do not intend to push on to a distant place looking for one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that you will end the walk if it is unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この入口から戻る経路も確認できます。お帰りの交通手段は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also check the route back from this entrance. How will you travel home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: バスです。散歩を続ける道より、バス停へ戻る道を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: バス停へ戻る道を優先して聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: By bus. Please show me the way back to the bus stop before the path for continuing my walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prioritize asking the way back to the bus stop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在通れる道を案内します。休憩所が利用できるとわかれば、そこへ向かいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will show you a path currently open. If the rest area is available, will you go there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 空席だけでなく屋根と距離も確認してから決めます。戻る時間が遅くなるなら今日は帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 設備と距離と帰りの時間を確認してから休憩所へ行くか決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide after checking the roof and distance, not just empty seats. If it makes my return late, I will go home today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to use the rest area after checking facilities, distance, and return time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。休憩所の現状と帰り道を確認し、雨の様子も見ながら選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check the current rest-area situation and return route, and choose while watching the rain too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの乗り場へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which platform are you heading for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二番乗り場です。エレベーターの印があったので、あれで直接行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二番乗り場へエレベーターで直接行けるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Platform two. I saw an elevator symbol. Does that elevator go there directly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the elevator goes directly to platform two. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 印のある設備がどの階につながるか確認しましょう。今は改札の外ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check which floors the marked equipment connects. You are currently outside the ticket gates, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ切符も通していません。改札までと乗り場までを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札前であり改札までと乗り場までの経路を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have not put my ticket through yet. Please explain the route to the gates separately from the route to the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are before the gates and ask for separate routes to the gates and platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 改札までの経路を先に案内します。階段を避けたい理由はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the route to the gates first. Is there a reason you want to avoid stairs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 足を痛めているので階段を避けたいです。ただ、介助なしで歩ける範囲で移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を避けたい事情と自力で歩く範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My leg is injured, so I want to avoid stairs. I will only move within the range I can walk without assistance, though.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to avoid stairs and the extent of independent walking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗り場までの設備の利用状況も確認します。もし一部使えない場合は係員への相談が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the equipment's availability up to the platform. If part is unavailable, you will need to consult staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。動いている印だと決めず、今使えるか確認してから改札へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の設備利用状況を確認してから進むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not assume the symbol means it is operating; I will check whether it can be used now before approaching the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check current facility availability before proceeding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要なら改札で担当者に経路を引き継ぎます。お一人で向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If needed, we will pass the route information to the staff at the gates. Are you going alone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。どの地点で次の係員に声をかければよいかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 途中で係員に相談する場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please also tell me where I should speak to the next staff member along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check where to consult staff along the route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 改札の案内窓口をお示しします。そこから乗り場までの経路を確認して進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will point out the information counter at the gates. From there, confirm the route to the platform before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の用紙でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with the moving-in form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、住所を書く欄が二つあります。両方とも今の住所を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの住所欄に同じ住所を書くのか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, there are two address fields. Should I write my current address in both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to write the same address in two fields. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 欄の見出しを一緒に確認しましょう。何と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the headings together. What do they say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一つは新住所、もう一つは前住所です。同じ情報を二回確認する欄だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所と前住所の見出しを読み誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One says new address and the other previous address. I thought they were asking me to confirm the same information twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the new and previous address headings and explain your misunderstanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 引っ越し前後を分ける欄ですね。まだ記入していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: They separate before and after the move. Have you not filled them in yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。新住所には今住んでいる家を、前住所には以前の家を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 引越し前後の住所を分けて書く意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I want to write where I live now for the new address and my former home for the previous address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write pre-move and post-move addresses separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 以前の住所がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have documents showing the previous address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 転出の書類を持っています。建物名が長いので、省略してよいか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転出書類を示し建物名の省略可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my moving-out documents. The building name is long, so I want to ask first whether I may abbreviate it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show moving-out documents and ask whether the building name can be abbreviated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な表記を担当に確認します。日付の欄にも不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check the required wording with the staff member. Do you also have questions about the date field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、用紙を書いている今日ではなく、実際に住み始めた日を書く欄か確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日付欄が記入日か実際の入居日か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please check whether it asks for the day I actually began living there rather than today when I am filling in the form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check whether the date field means completion date or actual move-in date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 住所と日付の欄を担当が説明します。資料を見ながら、該当する情報をそれぞれ記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will explain the address and date fields. Let us refer to your documents and enter the appropriate information in each.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約についてどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss about your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の予約を取り消して、翌週に移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約を取り消して別の週へ移したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to cancel next week's appointment and move it to the following week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to cancel and move the appointment to another week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取消だけでなく別の日への変更ですね。元の日時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you want to change to another date, not just cancel. Please tell me the original date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の木曜日の午前です。まだ取消の操作はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元の日時と未取消であることを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next Thursday morning. I have not performed any cancellation yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the original date and time and say it is not yet canceled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更できる枠を担当に確認します。翌週はどの時間帯をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check available slots for changing with the staff member. What time period do you prefer the following week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水曜日の午後が希望です。空きがなければ、ほかの日も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望時間帯と代替日の相談意向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wednesday afternoon. If nothing is available, I would like to discuss other days too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your preferred time period and willingness to discuss alternative dates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先に元の予約を取り消すかどうかは、変更方法を確認してから決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the change procedure before deciding whether to cancel the original appointment first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、新しい枠があると思い込んで元の予約を消さず、担当の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新枠を確認せず元予約を消さない方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not assume a new slot is available and delete the original; I will wait for the staff member's instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not delete the original booking without confirming a new slot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へつなぎます。変更が決まった後、何を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will connect you with the staff member. What will you check once the change is decided?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい日時だけでなく、元の予約がどう扱われたかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更後の新日時と元予約の状態の両方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not just the new date and time; I also want to check what happened to the original appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both the new date and time and the old booking's status after the change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの予約が残ったり、どちらもなくなったりしないよう、結果を担当と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the result with the staff member so that neither both appointments remain nor both disappear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車はどこに置かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Where did you park the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅の駐輪場です。三十五番なのに、そこに別の自転車がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐輪場の三十五番に別の自転車があったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At the station bicycle parking. It was number thirty-five, but another bicycle was there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that another bicycle was in parking spot thirty-five. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三十五番は自転車の登録番号ですか。それとも駐輪した場所の番号ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is thirty-five the bicycle's registration number or the number of its parking spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 場所の番号です。自転車の番号だと思ってメモしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三十五番は自転車ではなく場所の番号だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The spot number. I had noted it thinking it was the bicycle's number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct that thirty-five is a location number, not the bicycle number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駐輪場には列や区画の表示もありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did the parking area also have row or section signs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありましたが、列は覚えていません。数字だけで場所を探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列を記録せず数字だけで探したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, but I do not remember the row. I was searching only by the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you did not record the row and searched only by the number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず管理窓口で位置や移動の有無を確認することもできます。自転車自体の特徴はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can first ask the management desk about the location or whether it was moved. Do you know the bicycle's own features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤い車体で、かごの右側にへこみがあります。登録の控えも家にあるので確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車体の特徴と登録控えの確認予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has a red frame and a dent on the right side of the basket. I also have a registration copy at home, so I will check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the bicycle and your plan to check the registration copy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の自転車を自分のものだと決めて動かさないでください。最後に使った時刻はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do not decide another bicycle is yours and move it. When did you last use yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今朝八時ごろです。ほかの自転車には触れず、管理窓口と自分の控えを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最後の利用時刻を伝え他車に触れず管理窓口へ確認すると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Around eight this morning. I will not touch other bicycles; I will check with management and my own records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the last-use time and say you will check with management without touching other bicycles. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認した状況をお知らせください。紛失や盗難の届け出については、その情報も含めて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell us what you confirm. We will also ask for that information regarding a loss or theft report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような書類を送られますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申込書です。追跡番号があれば、この書類を入れた証明にもなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡番号が封筒の中身も証明するか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: An application form. If I have a tracking number, does it also prove that I put this document inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a tracking number also proves the envelope's contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送状況の確認と、中に何を入れたかの確認は分けて考える必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking delivery status needs to be considered separately from confirming what was placed inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうなのですね。追跡の表示だけで、申込書の内容まで確認できると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追跡表示で内容まで確認できると思った誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I thought the tracking display could confirm even the application form's contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that tracking also verifies contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先から指定された送付方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Has the submission destination specified a mailing method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内には追跡できる方法で送るとあります。中身の証明まで求めているかは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先の送付指定と不明な要件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions say to use a trackable method. They do not say whether proof of the contents is required too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the specified mailing method and uncertain requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その指定を確認して発送方法をご案内します。書類の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check those instructions and explain a shipping method. Have you kept a copy of the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: コピーを手元に残します。ただ、控えがあるだけで相手が受理したことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを残すが受理済みとは決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep a photocopy. But I will not treat having a copy as meaning the recipient has accepted it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep a copy but not assume acceptance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送後は配達状況を確認できます。受理については提出先へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check delivery status after mailing. Please check acceptance with the submission destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。配達と受理を分けて確認します。まず指定に合う発送方法と料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配達と受理を分け指定に合う発送方法と料金を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check delivery separately from acceptance. First, please tell me a method matching the instructions and its price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish delivery from acceptance and ask for a matching method and price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内を確認して方法と料金をご説明します。封を閉じる前に必要な書類もご自身で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the instructions and explain the method and price. Please also check the required documents yourself before sealing the envelope.
